verdict.rationale: Opting out of training on code and prompts is a fair question for a cloud-connected AI coding agent, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, data-retention control, or data-usage policy. Mentions of Business/Enterprise plans and RBAC concern access and permissions, not training data use, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
